DEINE ROLLE

Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – und du übernimmst dafür die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung. Als Creative Lead bist du Hauptansprechpartner:in für diesen Kunden und trägst die kreative Verantwortung: von der strategischen Ausrichtung über die konzeptionelle Qualität bis zur Führung deines Teams.
Es geht um Big Ideas, Kampagnen und Talkability. Nicht nur um das nächste Posting. Auch wenn du aus einem eher klassischen kreative Umfeld kommst, bist du bei uns richtig. Social-First-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du weißt, wie große Ideen entstehen und wie man ein Team dahin führt.

Als Creative Lead setzt du neue kreative Standards, holst neue Skillsets und Perspektiven ins Team und sorgst dafür, dass eure Arbeit den Unterschied macht – bei Kund:innen genauso wie bei renommierten Kreativ Wettbewerben.

WAS DU MACHST

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung deines Teams und bist damit für den kreativen Erfolg deines Hero Accounts mitverantwortlich
  • Du planst dein Team auf Projekte, steuerst Umsetzungen und bist die erste Instanz, wenn es um kreative Guidance und Qualitätssicherung geht
  • Du entwickelst Big Ideas sowie Konzepte mit, übersetzt Trends und Daten in relevante Kampagnenansätze und entwickelst den Kunden kreativ kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du baust die Creative Unit aktiv mit auf
  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in, gehst voran, gibst Feedback und entwickelst dein Team somit gezielt weiter
  • Du präsentierst eure Arbeiten strukturiert und sicher vor Kund:innen und Stakeholdern
  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Departments innerhalb der Agentur zusammen und reportest an unseren Creative Director

Stellenanforderungen

WAS DU BRAUCHST

  • Mehrjährige (6+) Berufserfahrung in Konzeption und Kreation – ob aus einer Social-First-Agentur, einer klassischen Werbeagentur oder einem gemischten Umfeld
  • (Erste) Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams
  • Ein Portfolio, das deine kreative Denke und deine Skills klar vermittelt
  • Motivation, einen Kunden von Grund auf kreativ zu formen und ein neues Department mit aufzubauen
  • Überblick und Weitsicht auch bei engen Timings sowie die Fähigkeit, dein Team sicher durch den Projektalltag zu führen

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Onboarding & Support
    No one likes to be the new kid. Mit strukturiertem Onboarding, einem persönlichen Mate und Zugang zu Lernmaterialien bist du ab Tag eine:r von uns.
  • Erstklassige Ausstattung
    Can’t work without my iPhone. Mit MacBook, iPhone und aktueller Apple-Tech arbeitest du flexibel und effizient. Das gilt für unsere Altbau-Offices genauso wie zuhause oder unterwegs.
  • Wachstum & Weiterentwicklung
    Rise & shine, darling! Dein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget gibt dir die Freiheit, in Workshops, Seminare, zertifizierte Kurse oder Coachings zu investieren. So entwickelst du dich genau in die Richtung, die zu deinen Zielen passt.
  • Flexibel arbeiten
    „Ob das bei euch gerade genauso ist? I doubt it!” Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du innerhalb der EU remote arbeiten. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle machen es leicht, Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Bei einem Umzug oder in besonderen Lebenssituationen wie einem Trauerfall erhältst du zusätzliche freie Tage.
  • Mehr Freizeit
    „It’s my birthday, I’mma spend my money.“ An deinem Geburtstag heißt es: Laptop zu und genießen. Zusätzlich sind der 24. Dezember und der 31. Dezember frei. Jubiläen und Geburtstage feiern wir mit kleinen Überraschungen.
  • Health & Wellbeing

Mit der Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft entscheidest du selbst, ob Yoga, Pilates, Schwimmen oder Krafttraining zu deinem Glow Up passt. nilo.health sorgt für mentale Stärke und bietet Sessions mit Psycholog:innen oder Coaches. Über deinen Zugang können auch bis zu fünf Familienmitglieder mitmachen.
  • Exklusive Deals & Extras
    It’s giving… perks! Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten bei Partnern wie plantclub, FutureBens und vielen mehr. Zusätzlich kannst du eines dieser drei Benefits wählen:
  • Givve Card – 50 € Guthaben pro Monat, frei einsetzbar für alles, was du liebst.
  • Mobiko – 65 € monatliches Mobilitätsbudget, nutzbar für Deutschlandticket, Tankkosten und alles, was kostet, um von A nach B zu kommen.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge – 50 € monatlicher Zuschuss zu deiner betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

Außerdem sind unsere Offices dog-friendly. Snacks, Obst und Drinks stehen allen Mates jederzeit kostenlos zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung von Schnittstellen zur Verbindung von Standardlösungen

  • Fehleranalyse, Störungsbeseitigung und kontinuierliche Prozessoptimierung

Tools & Technologien im Fokus:

  • Make & Zapier: Diese Low-Code-Plattformen ermöglichen dir, komplexe Workflows zu automatisieren, Systeme miteinander zu verbinden und datengetriebene Prozesse effizient umzusetzen. Du entwickelst automatisierte Abläufe zur Optimierung interner Geschäftsprozesse und sorgst für eine reibungslose Datenintegration zwischen verschiedenen Anwendungen.
  • HubSpot: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung und Optimierung von Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Serviceprozessen. Du implementierst Automatisierungen für Lead-Management, CRM-Prozesse und analysierst die Effektivität der Workflows.
  • Airtable: Flexible Datenbanklösung zur Organisation und Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen. Du konzipierst smarte Datenstrukturen, verbindest Airtable mit anderen Systemen und automatisierst Berichte sowie Dateneingaben.
  • API-Integrationen: Aufbau und Verwaltung von API-Schnittstellen zur nahtlosen Verbindung unterschiedlicher Softwarelösungen. Du entwickelst individuelle Schnittstellenlösungen, um bestehende Tools optimal zu integrieren und Arbeitsabläufe zu vereinfachen.
  • Künstliche Intelligenz: Implementierung und Nutzung von KI-basierten Lösungen zur Automatisierung komplexer Aufgaben. Dazu gehört die Integration von Machine-Learning-Modellen oder die Nutzung bestehender KI-Tools zur Prozessoptimierung.

Gehalt: 3800 Euro pro Monat (brutto)

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglich in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.

Wir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme. Die Übernahmequote liegt aktuell bei über 95%.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.
  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren und benötigen weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

  • Erfahrung in der Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und im Umgang mit API-Schnittstellen ist wünschenswert, aber nicht erforderlich
  • Kenntnisse in Tools wie Make, Zapier, HubSpot, Airtable und weiteren Automatisierungslösungen sind wünschenswert, aber nicht erforderlich

benuta gehört zu den führenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen für Teppiche und Wohnaccessoires in Europa. Wir glauben daran, dass gutes Design für alle zugänglich sein sollte – und inspirieren Menschen dabei, sich ein Zuhause zu schaffen, das sie lieben.

Als Brand Strategy Lead bist du verantwortlich für das kreative Fundament unserer Marke. Du entwickelst das ganzheitliche Markenleitbild weiter, das als Orientierung für alle Marketingkanäle dient – von Social Media über Kampagnen bis hin zu Content und Performance Marketing.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Performance Marketing, Content sowie Social & Influencer Marketing zusammen und stellst sicher, dass unsere Marke überall konsistent, inspirierend und klar erlebbar ist. Die folgenden Schwerpunkte prägen deine Arbeit maßgeblich:

Markenstrategie & Markenführung

  • Du entwickelst und schärfst die Markenstrategie von benuta
  • Du definierst unser Markenleitbild sowie zentrale Themen und Botschaften
  • Du übersetzt unsere Markenwerte in klare, anwendbare Prinzipien für alle Kanäle
  • Du stellst sicher, dass die Marke konsistent und differenzierend auftritt

Entwicklung von Brand Guidelines & Creative Frameworks

  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unsere Brand Guidelines (inkl. Tone of Voice, Bildsprache, Storytelling)

  • Du schaffst ein Framework, das Teams Orientierung gibt und gleichzeitig kreativen Spielraum lässt

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Performance, Content und Social Teams zusammen
  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Kampagnenideen und Storytelling-Ansätzen
  • Du übersetzt Insights aus verschiedenen Kanälen in neue kreative Ansätze
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams die Marke verstehen und konsistent umsetzen

Was wir uns wünschen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Brand Strategy, Markenführung oder in einer Kreativagentur
  • Ein starkes Gespür für Marken, Ästhetik und visuelles Storytelling
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Marken – idealerweise im DTC-, Interior-, Lifestyle- oder Fashion-Umfeld
  • Ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Kanäle, insbesondere Social Media und Performance Marketing
  • Die Fähigkeit, strategische Klarheit zu schaffen und diese in konkrete Leitlinien zu übersetzen
  • Eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, mit verschiedenen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten

We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context.

You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations.

You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments.

1. Core Risk Management & Governance

  • Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology

· Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role💻

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. Working hand in hand with developers, security specialists and AI researchers, you keep an overview in ambiguous situations, analyze systems and make well-founded decisions based on that analysis.

AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output.

Your Tasks

  • Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP.

  • Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output.

  • Create and curate agentic coding environments: custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools.

  • Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation.

  • Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery.

  • Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams.

  • Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear.

  • Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation.

What we offer you💼

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling, knowledge bases as the backbone of our AI workflows and room to push our engineering practices further

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Proven practice of AI-assisted engineering - you use LLMs for spec-driven development, runbook authoring or agentic coding and have seen it compound your own output

  • Deep knowledge of Linux/Unix internals, system administration and performance tuning

Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Für viele Mandant:innen bist du der Mensch, der endlich Klarheit bringt. Damit du dich voll darauf konzentrieren kannst, bekommst du bei uns digitale Tools, ein Team ohne Ellenbogen und ein Umfeld ohne Callcenter-Druck.

  • Nur eingehende Anfragen
    Du rufst niemanden unaufgefordert an und verschickst keine ungefragten E-Mails. Du betreust ausschließlich Menschen, die sich selbst bei uns gemeldet haben und Hilfe suchen.
  • Kein Callcenter-Feeling
    Bei uns gibt es keine Fließbandgespräche, keine starren Skripte und kein anonymes Großraumbüro. Du arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team mit eigenem Arbeitsplatz und kurzen Wegen, auch zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Digitale Tools statt Zettelwirtschaft
    Wir arbeiten digital und mit System, zum Beispiel mit HubSpot. Keine Excel-Listen und keine Zettel, sondern durchdachte Prozesse, die dir die Arbeit erleichtern.
  • Faires Gehalt & Sicherheit
    Wir schätzen deine Arbeit mit einer fairen, guten Bezahlung und geben dir mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag eine langfristige Perspektive.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Du unterstützt Menschen dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Am Ende des Tages weißt du, dass du vielen eine Sorge abgenommen hast.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein leistungsstarker Laptop, egal ob MacBook oder Windows.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Zentrale Lage, sehr gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätze direkt um die Ecke. Dazu ein Innenhof für die Pause und ein eigener Fitnessraum im Haus, kostenlos und jederzeit zugänglich.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Ellenbogenmentalität gibt es bei uns nicht, dafür echte Wertschätzung im Alltag und Events wie Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder Halloween-Sause. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin mit Massagen und kleinen Auszeiten für Entspannung.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Mitarbeiter im Kundenservice (w/m/d) bist du für viele Mandant:innen die erste Stimme von Migrando. Du beantwortest Fragen, gibst Orientierung und sorgst dafür, dass sich niemand mit seinem Anliegen allein gelassen fühlt.

  • Erste Anlaufstelle über alle Kanäle
    Ob Telefon, Ticketsystem oder Social Media: Du hilfst schnell und freundlich weiter, egal wo die Anfrage reinkommt.
  • Fragen rund um die Einbürgerung beantworten
    Du gibst Auskunft zu unseren Leistungen und erklärst, wie der Weg zum deutschen Pass bei uns abläuft.
  • Statusauskünfte zum Verfahren
    Du schaust im System nach, wo ein Vorgang gerade steht, und erklärst den nächsten Schritt so, dass ihn auch jemand ohne Fachwissen versteht.
  • Zuhören und verständlich erklären
    Viele unserer Mandant:innen lernen gerade erst Deutsch. Du hörst nicht nur, was gefragt wird, sondern erkennst, was dahintersteckt, findest Worte, die ankommen, und erklärst auch gern ein zweites Mal.
  • Termine und Rückrufe
    Du stimmst Rückrufe und Gesprächstermine ab und behältst im Blick, wer wann eine Rückmeldung erwartet.
  • Nachforderung fehlender Unterlagen
    Du erinnerst freundlich an offene Dokumente und erklärst, warum sie gebraucht werden.
  • Saubere Dokumentation
    Du hältst fest, was besprochen wurde, inklusive Rückmeldungen, Beschwerden und Lösungen. So haben alle Kolleg:innen den gleichen Stand.
  • Schnittstelle zur Sachbearbeitung und zum Anwaltsteam
    Wenn eine Frage tiefer geht, leitest du sie mit dem nötigen Kontext weiter und sorgst dafür, dass niemand zweimal dasselbe erzählen muss.
  • Umgang mit Beschwerden und Unmut
    Wenn jemand ungeduldig oder enttäuscht ist, bleibst du ruhig, nimmst das Anliegen ernst und findest gemeinsam eine Lösung.
  • Muster erkennen und Verbesserungen anstoßen
    Wenn dieselbe Frage ständig kommt, sagst du Bescheid. Daraus bauen wir bessere Infos, damit das Problem gar nicht erst entsteht.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern wie du mit Menschen umgehst und wie du arbeitest. Rechtliche Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, die Hintergründe zur Einbürgerung und unsere Systeme lernst du in der Einarbeitung kennen.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen
    Du hast schon in einem Job mit viel direktem Kontakt zu Menschen gearbeitet, ob im Kundenservice, im Einzelhandel, in der Gastronomie, im Hotel oder in der Beratung, und weißt, wie es ist, den ganzen Tag im Gespräch zu sein.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
    Deutsch ist dein tägliches Arbeitswerkzeug, am Telefon wie schriftlich. Alle weiteren Sprachen sind ein echtes Plus.
  • Klare, einfache Kommunikation
    Du kannst komplizierte Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie auch ohne Vorwissen verständlich sind.
  • Empathie und interkulturelle Offenheit
    Du arbeitest gern mit Menschen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Ländern und Lebenslagen und begegnest allen auf Augenhöhe.
  • Geduld und Ruhe
    Manche Fragen kommen zum dritten Mal, und manchmal ist jemand verärgert. Für dich ist das kein Problem: Du bleibst sachlich, freundlich und gelassen.
  • Zuverlässigkeit und Struktur
    Du behältst den Überblick, auch wenn viele Anfragen gleichzeitig reinkommen, vergisst keine Rückmeldung und dokumentierst sorgfältig, weil davon die Arbeit deiner Kolleg:innen abhängt.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem PC
    E-Mail, Telefon und digitale Tools sind für dich Alltag. Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen oder CRM-Systemen wie HubSpot ist ein Plus.
  • Diskretion
    Du gehst mit sensiblen Daten verantwortungsvoll um. Verschwiegenheit ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Kundenorientierung und Teamgeist
    Du willst den Menschen am Telefon wirklich helfen und arbeitest gleichzeitig gern mit deinen Kolleg:innen zusammen.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The role

As our MI Analyst, you will tell our Contact Centre leaders what the data means and what to do about it, then build the tools that deliver it at scale. You will sit in the Workforce Planning team, working across all teams who deal with customer contacts and report to the Head of Workforce Planning. Each day, week and month we publish reporting on agent productivity, operational performance and business review data across multiple teams and two sites. The job is to go beyond filling in the numbers and answer the "so what":

  • What are our most immediate opportunities?

  • What do we do about them with operational leaders?

  • Where are we losing efficiency?

  • Where could the same hours deliver more?

You will also use AI to do this faster than any manual process could. We run Claude connected to our BI data lake, so the right person can pull data, build reports and automate repeatable work themselves, without waiting in a queue. We want someone who sees that and immediately starts asking what they can automate.

What you will do

Find the insight

  • Turn Contact Centre data into clear findings and recommendations, and tell leaders what to do, not just what happened.

  • Spot where we are losing efficiency or capacity, size each opportunity, and prioritise the ones worth acting on.

  • Add commentary to the reports you publish, so readers see the story behind the numbers.

  • Own our understanding of contact drivers: explain why customers contact us, how that is changing, and what we could do to reduce it or handle it better.

Build with AI, at scale

  • Use Claude and our BI data lake to pull data, build reports and automate manual collation.

  • Replace repeatable, manual reporting with automated, reliable processes, so your time goes on analysis.

  • Bring us ideas for what to automate next, and show the time and capacity you save.

  • Document what you build so others in the team can run and maintain it when required.

Run the reporting cadence

  • Deliver daily, weekly and monthly reporting on agent productivity, utilisation and key service metrics across phone, email, chat and messaging.

  • Prepare the data for our daily, weekly and monthly business reviews (WBR and MBR).

  • Keep stakeholders updated on what you are working on and when it will land, without being asked.

Own accuracy

  • Validate every output before you share it. You are the last line of quality control on your own work.

  • Check sources and definitions rather than trusting historical reports, and flag anything that looks wrong before others find it.

  • Cross check your reports against the WBR and other sources, so mismatches show up before stakeholders spot them.

Be our Contact Centre data partner to BI

  • Act as the Contact Centre data partner to our BI teams, and the link between them and our operational leaders.

  • Help validate data models, dashboards and metrics against what is really happening on the floor.

  • Spot data issues early, raise them with BI with clear examples, and see them through to a fix.

  • Turn operational questions into clear requirements for BI, and help test what they build before it goes live.

  • Keep metric definitions consistent across Zendesk, Talkdesk, Calabrio and Looker.

Work with the business

  • Understand what team leaders and managers need from the data, and challenge whether our metrics are the right ones.

  • Help define and evolve Contact Centre KPIs as the business grows.

  • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting on test and learn initiatives, and on BPO partner performance.

What we are looking for

We want someone who has already worked with data in a busy operation and wants to do much more with it. If you are curious, thorough and keen to build, we want to hear from you.

You will need

  • Real curiosity about data. You ask why a number moved, not just what it is.

  • The ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation that a non-technical leader can act on.

  • Strong attention to detail, and the habit of sense checking your own work before anyone else sees it.

  • Experience as an analyst, with a real understanding of the data you work with: where it comes from, how it is built, and what it can and cannot tell you.

  • Hands on experience using AI tools such as Claude to analyse data or build things, or a strong track record of picking up new tools fast.

  • Strong written and spoken communication, including working with BI teams to validate data and proactively updating stakeholders on progress and delays.

  • A drive to take ownership, without being prompted, of the reports and processes you run.

  • The ability to manage daily and weekly deadlines in a fast moving operation.

It would be great if you have

  • Experience in a Contact Centre or operations environment, and working knowledge of how AHT, occupancy, SLA and productivity are measured and what moves them.

  • Experience with BigQuery, dbt, Looker Studio or similar BI tools.

  • Experience with Zendesk, Talkdesk or Calabrio data.

  • Examples of something you automated or built that saved real time.

Why join us

  • Claude connected to our BI data lake, so you can build with real, live data from day one.

  • Your work is used every morning by operational leaders to run the day and directly impacts business performance.

  • Room to move from running reports to owning our Ops reporting automation.

  • A small team where good ideas get picked up and shipped.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • £34,000 per annum

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

  • 33 days holiday (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

Equal Opportunities Statement

Motorway is committed to equality of opportunity for all employees. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximise their full potential. We believe our workforce should reflect a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives and experiences. Our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion is evident through our constant focus on recruiting, developing and advancing individuals based on their skills and talents.

We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships.

rawCandidates.title: Junior Python Software Engineer
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our New Products & Geographies Engineering team in London. This team launches and scales new lending propositions in two directions: bringing Abound’s lending to customers in new countries and expanding our B2B offering for partners. We move quickly, exploring ideas through production-ready MVPs and iterating as products mature.

This is a hybrid role, with at least three days a week in our London office. It’s a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship. We value engineers who are curious about the business and are keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and customer experience.

Our technology stack

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy and Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker and AWS.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested Python, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Work closely with our React frontend developers to build the APIs and backend logic their features rely on

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

Who you are:

You’ll need:

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Python – you don’t need to be an expert, but you’re comfortable writing, testing and debugging code

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and unit testing

  • Familiarity with SQL, relational databases and Git

  • To be able to work from our London office at least three days a week

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

We’re hiring a Security Engineering Lead to build and lead our security engineering team, reporting to the Head of Platform.

You’ll manage engineers working across product and platform security, set a clear direction for the function and help us grow our product security capability. You’ll join a small team with both specialisms already represented and shape how it develops.

Our product security engineers work alongside Product Engineering teams, contributing to planning, design, code and delivery. They report to you for technical development, performance and career progression. You’ll stay close enough to their work to support them well, even when you are not part of their day-to-day team.

You’ll bring experience as a security engineer and as a people manager. You should be able to challenge a design, reason through a threat model and help an engineer find a practical solution. You’ll also need to make choices about where we invest, build relationships across engineering and explain security priorities in terms of customer and business risk.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop our product and platform security engineers through regular feedback, coaching, clear expectations and fair performance assessment.

  • Build a focused security engineering strategy and roadmap, informed by our products, engineering plans and the risks that matter most.

  • Grow the team thoughtfully, identifying capability gaps and taking responsibility for hiring and onboarding.

  • Agree sustained product security placements with engineering leaders, with clear priorities, useful feedback and a strong connection to the security team.

  • Help teams build security into architecture and implementation, including access control, tenant isolation, confidential data handling and AI systems.

  • Work with Platform Engineering to make secure infrastructure and delivery practices easy to adopt, using shared controls and automation where they help.

  • Stay involved in important technical decisions through design and code reviews, investigations and selective implementation.

  • Help engineers raise concerns and resolve disagreements constructively. Make material risks and trade-offs clear to the leaders accountable for the decision.

  • Partner with IT and Information Security on shared risks, incident response and assurance requirements.

  • Measure whether our approach reduces meaningful risk and helps engineers deliver securely. Use what we learn to improve it.


What we’re looking for

  • A background in hands-on security engineering, with strong product or application security experience.

  • Demonstrated line management experience: developing engineers, giving difficult feedback, assessing performance and supporting career progression.

  • Experience supporting engineers whose daily work happens within other teams, or comparable evidence of managing effectively without observing all their work directly.

  • Current technical judgement across secure software design, threat modelling, authentication, authorisation and protection of sensitive data.

  • Enough cloud and platform security breadth to guide specialists and make sound decisions across both areas.

  • Experience setting priorities and securing support for security improvements across engineering teams.

  • The ability to explain risk clearly, offer workable options and make proportionate recommendations under uncertainty.

  • A collaborative approach that helps product and platform engineers own the security of the systems they build.

You should be comfortable reading and reviewing production code and discussing implementation choices. The role combines technical leadership with people management and responsibility for building the function.


Useful experience

  • Working with AWS, backend services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

  • Securing multi-tenant products, confidential customer data or AI-enabled systems.

  • Building or improving a small security engineering team in a growing organisation.

  • Introducing secure patterns or tooling that engineers adopted and continued to use.

We value evidence of sound judgement and useful outcomes. You do not need experience with every technology we use.

What success looks like

During your first months, you’ll understand the team’s strengths, our main risks and how security work gets done. You’ll agree development plans with the engineers and establish clear working relationships with Product Engineering, Platform and Information Security.

Over the following months, you’ll put a prioritised roadmap and a workable embedded model in place. Teams should involve security earlier in important decisions, engineers should have useful technical support, and the highest-priority improvements should have clear owners and delivery capacity.

As the function grows, we’ll look for evidence of better protection for customers, adoption of secure engineering practices and a team whose engineers are developing in their roles.

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. rawCandidates.title: GTM Engineer
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain that moves them from donation to resale is offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We run a B2B marketplace where resellers and stores buy clothing in bulk, and we build the AI systems that digitise the supply chain behind it.

Our buyers sell on eBay, Vinted, Depop, Whatnot, eBay Live and TikTok Shop, or run vintage stores from Brick Lane to Paris to New York. They source graded stock from wholesalers and rag houses across many countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise an item from a single photo.

We are now going well beyond vintage. Live sellers can sell almost anything, and there is an opportunity for Fleek to be the backend for B2B resale. We've now started onboarding customers alongside supply from Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill and tripled in size year on year. We've raised ~$50M from a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital and others, and recently closed our Series B. Our advisors and private investors include operators behind Depop, Shopify and Postmates.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it.

About the role

You'll join the GTM team as our GTM Engineer, reporting to our GTM lead and working day to day with the new business team. You'll own the system we use to find and win customers, on both sides of the marketplace.

On the demand side, that means online resellers, live sellers and physical stores in the UK, Europe and the US, buying vintage, deadstock, new with tags and luxury. On the supply side, it means the brands, brokers, wholesalers and rag houses who sell to them. As we add new categories and markets, the system has to find those customers too.

We already have pipelines that scrape marketplaces and load leads into our CRM. The next step is everything after that: putting the right leads first, reaching them well, and learning from every outcome. You'll own the engine end to end, from the first scrape to the revenue each new customer brings in.

This is not a typical B2B SaaS GTM engineering role. You won't spend your days wiring a CRM to a LinkedIn sequencer or building dashboards. Everyone on our commercial team builds their own tools with AI. You'll take on the problems they can't: systems that improve themselves, infrastructure that scales, and outreach that works within limits set by platforms like Meta.

The role is part engineer, part product manager and part commercial. You won't carry a closes target, but you'll own every metric that moves it.

The problem you'll solve

We want a system that finds the right customers, puts them in order, reaches out, and gets better every week. It runs as a loop:

  1. Find. Source leads across marketplaces and social platforms, for every segment and market we sell into.

  2. Prioritise. Score each lead on the signals that predict a good customer, not just a likely reply.

  3. Reach out. Contact them on Instagram, WhatsApp, email, phone or LinkedIn, personalised by AI and handed to a rep at the right moment.

  4. Learn. Feed every outcome back into scoring. If a store replied but wasn't a fit, similar leads drop down the list, so we stop spending tokens and rep time on them. Then back to step 1.

To make that loop work, you'll build a second brain for GTM: one layer that holds everything we know about a customer, with models and agents running on top. That includes the messages we sent and how they replied, how fast they replied and closed, what they sell and where, what they click and search for in our app, what they told our reps on calls, and how much they spend and how well they retain.

The same data powers our account management team, who look after customers once they've placed their first orders. Matching each buyer with the right supply is one of their next big problems, and you'll help solve it.

What you'll do

  • Own the acquisition engine. Learn how our current pipelines work and improve them. If a rebuild is the right call, make the case for it, and keep leads flowing to the reps while you build.

  • Source at scale in new segments. Find vintage stores, live sellers, deadstock and luxury buyers, and new suppliers, in every market we enter.

  • Build the scoring and feedback loop. Define what a good lead looks like for each segment, then keep refining it on what actually closes and what actually spends.

  • Engineer multi-channel outreach. Instagram, WhatsApp, email, calls and LinkedIn, personalised by AI and built around real limits like Instagram DM caps and Meta restrictions.

  • Own the funnel numbers. Leads sourced per day on each platform, reply rate, conversion rate and GMV per close by source. Use them to decide what to fix next.

  • Sit with the reps and talk to customers. Learn why a lead is good and how each segment wants to be sold to. Then automate the repetitive parts of the rep's day.

  • Turn repeat work into agents. Qualification, first messages, reply handling, dedupe and CRM hygiene should run without a person.

  • Keep it efficient. Every system you build should make sense on cost per lead and unit economics.

  • Connect acquisition to retention. Make sure new customers land cleanly with account management, and help build the buyer-to-supply matching they rely on.

What you bring

  • A strong technical background. You've built and run real systems, such as data pipelines, scrapers, models or production infrastructure. You've done more than configure tools.

  • An AI-first mindset, a step ahead. You build with Claude and other models every day and know where agents work and where they break. Our commercial team is very AI-literate, and you'll push them further.

  • Curiosity about the customer. You want to know why one lead closes and another doesn't, and how each segment wants to be sold to. You're happy on a call with a reseller.

  • Problem solving over playbooks. You take an ambiguous problem, form your own view and ship something that works. We'd rather hire someone who works it out than someone repeating what worked elsewhere.

  • Experience building for marketplaces, resellers, live selling or independent retail

  • Running multi-channel outbound under platform limits (DM caps, deliverability, warm-up)

What good looks like

  • First 30 days: you know the current pipelines inside out, have sat with the reps and have shipped your first improvements, with leads still flowing. You've shared your plan to improve what's there or rebuild it, and why.

  • 3 months: one data layer joins outreach, replies, closes, app activity, call notes and spend. Scoring runs on it, and the loop from outcome back to scoring is live for at least one segment.

What you'll get

  • Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!)

How we work

High ownership, non-hierarchical and fast-moving. We hire problem solvers, not order takers. If you have a better way to do something, and it moves the numbers at a sensible cost, go for it.

Our values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do

You'll own the operational backbone that connects what we sell to what we bill: turning executed contracts and agent usage into accurate bookings and reports, and turning the data behind both into critical insights the business acts on. This role sits at the center of the company’s business model and works across Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, GTM Systems, and Agent Development.

Own order management across the customer lifecycle

  • Own the path from signature to booking: build, verify, and book quotes across the customer lifecycle, capturing all critical commercial terms

  • Collaborate across GTM Operations, Finance, and Sales Compensation to ensure bookings flow accurately into all downstream systems and reporting

  • Leverage and spearhead order management guides and best practices, influencing policies and processes as new terms and products emerge

Accelerate usage tracking and reporting

  • Partner with Agent Development to set up, verify, and maintain outcome-based usage tracking across agents

  • Run the monthly consumption reporting and billing cycle for our growing customer base, delivering key reports to the company and to the Customer

  • Serve as the owner for usage questions from customers, Sales, and Agent Development

Support our deal operations and velocity

  • Draft, review, and execute order forms, working with our Pricing team to align on commercial negotiation, deal forecast, and downstream operability

  • Partner with Sales, Legal, Pricing, and Finance across the deal lifecycle to execute deals cleanly and drive scalability over time

Build the operational machine with us

  • Continuously identify repetitive processes across the order management lifecycle and collaborate across the Go-to-Market Operations team to automate and scale them

  • Work with Revenue Operations and GTM systems to define billing processes and policies for new products and pricing models

  • Ramp from running standard processes to owning complex and ambiguous scenarios

What you’ll bring

  • 2–4 years in deal desk, order management, billing operations, or revenue operations at a B2B SaaS company

  • Experience owning an operational booking and/or billing queue end-to-end with high accuracy against monthly deadlines

  • Experience with CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) and a CPQ or billing system; comfortable reading a contract and translating terms into system fields

  • Strong attention to detail and clear written communication skills to collaborate with Sales, Finance, Legal, and customers

  • Ability to identify areas for improvement and build solutions using AI tooling

  • Based in San Francisco and able to work in-office with the team

Even Better…

  • Experience with usage-based billing (commitments, overages, credits, true-ups)

  • Familiarity with Quoting and Contract Lifecycle Management tools

  • SQL or spreadsheet modeling skills

  • Exposure to sales compensation, revenue recognition, or partner and reseller billing

  • Experience at a high-growth company where you helped stand up a process from scratch

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
You make every rep and every manager on our commercial team better, every week, so we win more of the deals that matter.

WHAT WE ARE BUILDING AT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to hear from real people at scale and turn what they say into decisions.

#1 WHAT PROBLEM ARE WE SOLVING

In a year our commercial team has grown to 60+ client-facing people across New York, San Francisco, London and Antwerp, and we’re doubling again. Hiring great people is only half the job. The other half is making every one of them great, fast, and keeping them there. That’s this role.

#2 THE TEAM YOU WILL JOIN

You’ll report to our VP Sales and work hand in hand with Talent Development, who are building our enablement system: the knowledge hub, the competency framework and the skills data behind it. You make that system real on the ground: on calls, in deals and in 1:1s. You’ll work every day with our Sales Directors, Client Growth Managers, Research Impact Leads and the managers who lead them, and closely with Sales leadership, Product Marketing and GTM Ops.

#3 HOW WE OPERATE

  • Relentless ownership. See it. Own it. Don’t wait to be asked.

  • Low ego, radical candor. Say the hard thing because you care.

  • Think AI first. Start from the agent, not the spreadsheet.

  • Speed. We execute with the smallest possible team. We work hard and we have fun.

THE ROLE

As Sales Enablement Lead, you own how our reps and managers get better. You coach in the field, turn our skills and pipeline data into action, and hold reps and managers to the development plans they commit to.

This is not a role for building slide decks or running a learning platform. It’s for someone who has carried a number, knows exactly what good sounds like on a call, and wants to get a whole team performing at that level.

YOUR MISSION

1. Coach the field

  • Run weekly call reviews, deal clinics and live sessions across Sales, Client Growth and Research Impact.

  • Lift the skills that win complex deals: deep discovery, building the business case, multi-threading and closing with a clear next step.

  • Bring top performers into the room so what works spreads across the team, and design and run the enablement at our team off-sites.

Your bar: reps feel the difference on their next call, not next quarter.

2. Coach the coaches

  • Work with every sales manager on how they coach, not just on what their team does.

  • Prepare managers for 1:1s with each rep’s skills data, and agree development plans together.

Your bar: managers run sharper 1:1s because you’ve been in them.

3. Turn data into action

  • Read call-skills scores alongside pipeline, win rates and stage velocity, and spot the patterns by role, region and stage.

  • Decide where coaching goes next, then prove whether it moved the numbers.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a Junior IT support analyst to join our TechOps team, reporting to the Senior IT support analyst. This role will help us deliver outstanding IT support to Seccl staff as we continue to scale.

Our TechOps team sits within Engineering and underpins Seccl’s modern workplace. It’s a fast moving, collaborative environment with plenty of variety, from supporting joiners, movers and leavers, to managing the Mac device lifecycle and SaaS admin. You’ll quickly build hands on experience with the latest tech.

What you’ll own

  • Act as the first point of contact for internal IT queries, owning triage and providing first contact resolution where possible

  • Meet first response SLAs and keep colleagues updated on ticket progress through clear, friendly communication

  • Support the joiner / mover / leaver process, from equipment provisioning and account setup to access changes and deactivation, maintaining an accurate IT asset register

  • Keep endpoints compliant with our security standards in a Mac first environment

  • Use our ticketing tools (e.g., Jira Service Management) and suggest pragmatic improvements to workflows and automation

This role’s for you if...

  • You’ve used Jamf or other endpoint management (e.g., Intune) and understand the basics (desirable)

  • You’ve used Jira Service Management or similar ticketing systems and/or the Atlassian suite (desirable)

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re less comfortable in people-facing roles. As the first port of call for IT issues, and one of the first faces employees meet as they join Seccl, strong people skills are essential!

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £27,000 - £30,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Interview process

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
AI Solutions Engineer - R&D

 

➡️ Do you understand how R&D and engineering teams work, from technical research and technology evaluation through to product development and innovation?

➡️ Have you gone beyond using AI to actually building solutions, integrating APIs, developing agents or automating complex workflows?

➡️ Can you combine hands-on technical capability with the confidence to engage enterprise customers, understand their challenges and design solutions that deliver real value?

 

If this sounds like your next move, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

We have an exciting new role as an AI Solutions Engineer to support our R&D customers.

You’ll work alongside Account Executives and Account Managers throughout the sales process, speaking directly with prospective customers to understand their R&D and data workflows, uncover what they’re trying to achieve, and design AI-powered solutions around those needs. This isn’t a role where you simply demo an existing product. You’ll be expected to build and tailor the solution for the customer — using Patsnap’s data, APIs, MCP capabilities and AI tools to create agents, workflows, prototypes and proof-of-concepts that bring their use case to life.

The brief is simple:

Understand the customer. Build the solution. Prove the value.

We’re looking for people who can bring together:

Domain knowledge + customer-facing experience + real AI build capability

A typical day could involve joining several customer calls, running technical discovery, building a prototype between meetings, demonstrating it live to a prospect, refining it based on feedback and, where needed, supporting deployment after signature.

We're looking for someone who brings together three core strengths:

  • R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding: You understand how R&D, engineering and innovation teams operate, the challenges they face and where AI can deliver value.

  • Customer-Facing & Commercial Capability: You're confident engaging enterprise customers, leading technical discovery and translating requirements into compelling solutions.

  • Hands-On AI Development: You can independently build AI agents, integrations, automated workflows and technical prototypes, rather than simply demonstrating existing software.

You'll use Patsnap's proprietary R&D and innovation intelligence, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities and AI technologies to design, build and demonstrate solutions tailored to customer needs.

That could involve developing an AI agent to accelerate technical research, integrating Patsnap's intelligence into existing enterprise systems, automating technology scouting processes or creating intelligent workflows to support engineering and product development decisions.

You'll take customer challenges from initial discovery through to working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, demonstrating how AI can deliver meaningful improvements to their R&D processes.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. You won’t be expected to build production software from scratch, but you will need to be technically confident, comfortable building independently and credible in front of enterprise customers.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position in our London, UK office, working 1–2 days in the office and the rest from home.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research and Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead. 

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Singapore, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.   

Why Join Patsnap?

  • Build with AI every day. Design and develop AI agents, technical workflows, integrations and prototypes that address real customer challenges.

  • Work at the forefront of R&D innovation. Help leading organisations transform how they approach research, technology discovery, engineering and product development.

  • Go beyond traditional pre-sales. You'll have the freedom to design and build tailored solutions rather than simply demonstrate existing software.

  • Make a tangible commercial impact. See your technical work directly influence customer decisions, accelerate opportunities and support enterprise adoption.

  • Help shape our AI capabilities. Work closely with Product and Engineering, bringing real customer requirements into the development of scalable solutions.

  • Join at an exciting stage of growth. Be part of Patsnap's continued investment in agentic AI, enterprise integrations and the evolution of our Solution Consulting function.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to support complex enterprise opportunities across R&D, engineering, product development and innovation.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with customers, understanding their existing research processes, engineering workflows, systems, data requirements and business challenges.

  • Design, build and demonstrate AI agents, intelligent workflows, integrations and proof-of-concepts using Patsnap's APIs, MCP capabilities, LLMs and other relevant technologies.

  • Translate real-world R&D use cases, such as technology scouting, technical literature analysis, engineering research, competitive intelligence and product innovation, into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • Integrate Patsnap's proprietary intelligence into customer workflows, internal systems and AI applications.

  • Deliver tailored technical demonstrations that clearly communicate how proposed solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.

  • Own proof-of-concept development from initial requirements and solution design through to testing, iteration and customer presentation.

  • Support technical implementation and deployment following signature, collaborating with Product, Engineering and Customer Success where required.

  • Identify opportunities to develop reusable workflows, templates and solution frameworks that can be applied across customers.

  • Share customer insights and technical feedback to help shape Patsnap's future AI capabilities.

  • You won't carry an individual sales quota, but your contribution will be measured through the commercial opportunities you help progress and close.


What We'd Love From You:

There are three equally important parts to this role:

1) R&D & Engineering Workflow Understanding

  • Strong understanding of R&D and engineering workflows, including how organisations approach technical research, technology scouting, product development, innovation and technical decision-making.

  • Experience working within or supporting engineering, industrial R&D, manufacturing, technology development or other research-intensive environments.

  • Ability to understand the challenges faced by R&D and engineering teams, including fragmented data, complex research processes, information discovery and opportunities for workflow automation.

  • Confidence engaging with technical stakeholders, understanding their requirements and translating these into practical AI-powered solutions.

  • A background in engineering, technical consulting, industrial technology, scientific software or a related discipline would be advantageous.

2) Customer-Facing Experience

  • Experience working directly with customers or prospects in areas such as pre-sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, consulting or technical delivery.

  • Confidence leading discovery and requirements conversations.

  • Able to explain complex scientific and technical concepts clearly.

  • Comfortable presenting and demonstrating solutions live.

  • Good commercial judgement: you know when to go deeper technically and when to focus on business value.

3) Hands-On AI Experience

You must already have experience building with AI, not simply using LLMs for everyday productivity.

We care less about whether something reached production and more about whether you have personally built, tested and iterated something that solved a real problem.

That might include:

  • AI agents or agentic workflows

  • LLM-powered applications

  • APIs and integrations

  • MCP

  • RAG or data-driven AI applications

  • Workflow automation

  • Prompt-based systems

  • Rapid prototypes or proof-of-concepts

Comfort with APIs, no-code/low-code tools, data and light scripting such as Python is a strong plus.

Backgrounds That Could Fit

You might currently work as a:

  • Solutions Engineer / Solution Consultant

  • Technical Pre-Sales Consultant

  • Product Manager / Product Owner

  • Technical or Implementation Consultant

  • Business or Product Analyst

  • Scientific Software Consultant

  • Life Sciences Technology Consultant

We’re typically looking for around 3–4 years of relevant professional experience, although the quality and relevance of your experience matters more than an exact number.

Benefits & Perks:

A culture we’re genuinely proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares knowledge, raises standards and celebrates wins properly together. You’ll have plenty of ownership, work with smart people across the business and be encouraged to keep learning and experimenting. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.


About the role

We are looking for a Director, Commercial Partnerships to lead Insider One’s technology and solution partner ecosystem across the United Kingdom, Ireland and the Nordics.

You will own the regional partnership strategy and its commercial results: identifying where partners can accelerate growth, building mutually valuable relationships, and turning those relationships into qualified pipeline, revenue and customer success.

Your portfolio will span complementary technology providers and solution partners, including agencies, consultancies and systems integrators. You will bring these partners together with Insider One’s regional sales and customer teams to develop compelling customer propositions and repeatable routes to market.

  • Develop and execute a commercial partnership plan aligned with growth priorities across UK&I and the Nordics.

  • Build referral and co-selling motions that connect partner teams with Insider One’s regional sellers.

    • Develop solution partnerships

  • Build a compelling commercial proposition that connects Insider One’s growth with partners’ opportunities to generate services revenue and deepen customer relationships.

  • Work with internal specialists to help partners develop the knowledge and capabilities required to recommend, implement and support Insider One.

  • Connect solution and technology partners around shared customer opportunities, combining platform capabilities with implementation and strategic services.

    • Deliver commercial outcomes

  • Own agreed targets for partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, alongside clearly defined partner contributions to sales and expansion opportunities.

  • Work with account executives on named-account plans, customer introductions, opportunity qualification and joint pursuits.

  • Establish executive and field relationships within priority partners, securing commitment to specific opportunities and growth plans.

  • Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns and events tied to named audiences, opportunity creation and pipeline progression.

  • Maintain accurate opportunity records, attribution and forecasts in Salesforce, with clear next steps and ownership.

    • Build a repeatable operating model

  • Equip Insider One and partner teams to recognize opportunities, articulate joint value and work together effectively.

  • Establish practical rules of engagement for referrals, co-selling, deal registration and customer handoffs.

  • Evaluate partner performance through pipeline quality, revenue, conversion, customer outcomes and economic value for both organizations.

  • Use evidence to refine the portfolio, expand successful motions and redirect investment where results fall short.


    • What you will bring

  • Significant experience in commercial partnerships, alliances or channel development within enterprise SaaS, with a track record of delivering measurable growth.

  • Experience building and activating both technology and solution partnerships, including agencies, consultancies or systems integrators.

  • Strong knowledge of the UK&I and Nordic markets, with relevant ecosystem relationships and the ability to build new ones.
